fields.why: Table 1 gives site-specific rates for 4 race groups, each marked against the White referent, and for 8 age groups.
Race has 4 groups (White, Black, AI/AN, API) compared; age has 8 ordered groups shown; ethnicity and sex are 2-group contrasts and states are geography.

Race rates carry the 'differed significantly from the rate in the referent group' mark (White referent): per-group vs referent only; age-specific rates are only shown in Table 1 with no test or text claim, which is side by side.
